title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 11 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 10 July 2026 Several spells of showers will occur in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Few showers may occur in Western and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 2.00 p.m. Strong winds about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the Central hills, North-central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Monaragala, Puttalam, Hambantota, Trincomalee and Mannar districts. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
